metric_hierarchy.unit: metres, seconds, trips, or GPS updates
metric_hierarchy.source: sealed trip sessions and accepted location evidence
metric_hierarchy.vintage: event time plus analytics formula version
metric_hierarchy.uncertainty: Completeness and quality scores describe collection quality; movement does not prove that a person saw an advert.
metric_hierarchy.missing_data: Mark the period incomplete and omit affected totals; never zero-fill missing route evidence.

metric_hierarchy.source: impressions_v1 output over verified vehicle movement and the applicable traffic profile
metric_hierarchy.calibration: Traffic-density parameters are configured operational defaults recorded in a versioned traffic profile; no independent field calibration or external traffic survey has been applied.
metric_hierarchy.vintage: traffic-profile effective interval, source fingerprint, formula version, and calculation time
metric_hierarchy.uncertainty: Show the model label, formula version, source vintage, and confidence diagnostic. Confidence is not a statistical confidence interval.
metric_hierarchy.missing_data: Omit the measure when movement, traffic profile, formula version, or provenance is absent; never infer unique people.

metric_hierarchy.source: approved target-zone geometry and disclosure-cleared fixed coverage cells with qualifying movement evidence
metric_hierarchy.vintage: zone revision, fixed-cell scheme, measurement period, disclosure decision revision, and calculation time
metric_hierarchy.uncertainty: Coverage describes geographic evidence, not people, views, reach, or causal effect. The approved live label and qualifying-evidence threshold are MISSING.
metric_hierarchy.missing_data: Omit the percentage if zone geometry, qualifying evidence, disclosure clearance, or a complete measurement period is absent.

candidate_formula.numerator: union area of disclosure-cleared fixed cells intersecting the approved target zone and containing qualifying movement evidence
candidate_formula.denominator: area of the immutable approved target-zone geometry for the measurement period

metric_hierarchy.source: immutable payout calculation and ledger facts
metric_hierarchy.vintage: payout rule/formula revision, currency, calculation revision, and report cutoff
metric_hierarchy.uncertainty: A campaign cost is not revenue, conversion value, incremental value, or ROI.
metric_hierarchy.missing_data: Omit unavailable currency totals; never combine currencies or substitute zero.

metric_hierarchy.unit: ratio or percent defined by the approved method
metric_hierarchy.source: advertiser conversion and revenue inputs plus approved cost and attribution inputs
metric_hierarchy.vintage: approved method revision and immutable input-manifest cutoff
metric_hierarchy.uncertainty: Display the method's limitations, exclusions, corrections, attribution window, and provenance beside the result.
metric_hierarchy.limitations: Return on investment is computed from advertiser-supplied conversion and revenue inputs that Cardvert does not verify. It is not causal lift, incremental value, verified exposure, or attribution of a person to an advert, and modelled potential contacts are never one of its inputs.
metric_hierarchy.missing_data: Omit the entire ROI section and claim when any gate prerequisite is absent.

all_required: advertiser conversion input with schema, provenance, currency where applicable, and reporting cutoff
advertiser revenue input with schema, provenance, currency, and reporting cutoff
reproducible attribution rule and attribution window
defined positive cost basis and currency-consistency rule
defined exclusions, corrections, late-data handling, and reissue rule
immutable input manifest and method revision
roi_gate.on_missing_or_invalid: Omit the ROI section, metric, comparison, and claim; do not estimate, imply, rename, or substitute performance measures.
roi_gate.synthetic_fixture_exception: A fixture may exercise the gate only when test_only=true and every input and method is labelled synthetic; it grants no live approval.

correction_and_reissue.rule: A changed input, source vintage, formula, approval, or correction creates a new run and reissue lineage; never mutate an issued result in place.
correction_and_reissue.live_use_limit: Immutable runs and reissue lineage are built; live issuance remains disabled until the recorded method and privacy gates are approved.

prohibited_claims: ROI when the ROI gate does not pass

completeness_rule.denominator: Cohort trips whose session reached a terminal ended or sealed state inside the frozen reporting period.
completeness_rule.in_progress_handling: Trips still active at the period boundary are disclosed separately and are never counted in the denominator.
completeness_rule.disclosure: Every published metric states its covered trip count, the denominator, and the insufficient-data and excluded trip counts for the period.
completeness_rule.suppression: A metric total is omitted when the metric covers no qualifying trip, or when a required provenance input is absent. Omission never substitutes zero.
completeness_rule.consistency: Screen, CSV and PDF publish the one frozen completeness and suppression decision; no surface recomputes it.
